name: Grilled Cod Tacos with Spicy Tomato-Cilantro Salsa & Lettuce

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place oil and spices in a large bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, add cod to the bowl with the spice paste and turn to coat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add cod and grill until the flesh is opaque and flakey, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
6 tomatoes
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl.
Add oil, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Separate lettuce leaves, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Use a fork to break the cod into bite-sized pieces.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with grilled cod, salsa, and lettuce. Enjoy!
